draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2 fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1 fp32) support the numbers. The claim's "faster" is a direct comparison of the two reported latencies, which is supported. However, the two latencies were measured on different accelerators/precisions, so the comparison is not apples-to-apples; the claim as stated is acceptable but could note the differing measurement conditions. The numbers and direction are accurate.
